BillHistory.ReferredCommittee: Referred to Committee on Commerce & Labor.

BillHeading.BriefDescription: Requiring employee organizations to submit digital copies of their collective bargaining agreements to the public employment relations commission.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to employee organizations submitting digital copies of their collective bargaining agreements to the public employment relations commission; adding a new section to chapter 41.56 RCW; adding a new section to chapter 41.80 RCW; adding a new section to chapter 41.76 RCW; adding a new section to chapter 41.59 RCW; adding a new section to chapter 49.39 RCW; adding a new section to chapter 28B.52 RCW; adding a new section to chapter 47.64 RCW; adding a new section to chapter 49.66 RCW; and adding a new section to chapter 41.58 RCW.

BillSection.BillSectionHeader: Sec. 1. A new section is added to chapter 41.56 RCW to read as follows:
BillSection.P: Bargaining representatives representing public employees under this chapter shall submit a digital copy of their collective bargaining agreement to the commission within thirty days of the effective date of the collective bargaining agreement.

BillSection.BillSectionHeader: Sec. 2. A new section is added to chapter 41.80 RCW to read as follows:
BillSection.P: Employee organizations representing public employees under this chapter shall submit a digital copy of their collective bargaining agreement to the commission within thirty days of the effective date of the collective bargaining agreement.

BillSection.BillSectionHeader: Sec. 3. A new section is added to chapter 41.76 RCW to read as follows:
BillSection.P: Employee organizations representing faculty public employees under this chapter shall submit a digital copy of their collective bargaining agreement to the commission within thirty days of the effective date of the collective bargaining agreement.

BillSection.BillSectionHeader: Sec. 4. A new section is added to chapter 41.59 RCW to read as follows:
BillSection.P: Employee organizations representing educational public employees under this chapter shall submit a digital copy of their collective bargaining agreement to the commission within thirty days of the effective date of the collective bargaining agreement.

BillSection.BillSectionHeader: Sec. 5. A new section is added to chapter 49.39 RCW to read as follows:
BillSection.P: Labor unions representing symphony musicians under this chapter shall submit a digital copy of their collective bargaining agreement to the commission within thirty days of the effective date of the collective bargaining agreement.

BillSection.BillSectionHeader: Sec. 6. A new section is added to chapter 28B.52 RCW to read as follows:
BillSection.P: Employee organizations representing academic employees under this chapter shall submit a digital copy of their collective bargaining agreement to the commission within thirty days of the effective date of the collective bargaining agreement.

BillSection.BillSectionHeader: Sec. 7. A new section is added to chapter 47.64 RCW to read as follows:
BillSection.P: Ferry employee organizations representing ferry employees under this chapter shall submit a digital copy of their collective bargaining agreement to the commission within thirty days of the effective date of the collective bargaining agreement.

BillSection.BillSectionHeader: Sec. 8. A new section is added to chapter 49.66 RCW to read as follows:
BillSection.P: Employee organizations representing employees under this chapter shall submit a digital copy of their collective bargaining agreement to the department within thirty days of the effective date of the collective bargaining agreement. The department shall maintain a web site that allows the public to view and download the collective bargaining agreements submitted by labor unions pursuant to this section. The collective bargaining agreements shall be available in a uniform digital format. Expired collective bargaining agreements shall be available on the web site for up to ten years following expiration.

BillSection.BillSectionHeader: Sec. 9. A new section is added to chapter 41.58 RCW to read as follows:
BillSection.P: The commission shall maintain a web site that allows the public to view and download the collective bargaining agreements submitted by labor unions pursuant to this act. The collective bargaining agreements shall be available in a uniform digital format. Expired collective bargaining agreements shall be available on the web site for up to ten years following expiration.
